'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Zach Tollefson DS Coruscant''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Zach Tollefson]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition)|SE-D-coruscant.gif|label=Coruscant}}
* '''Deck name:''' Quasi Coruscant Mains
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
